title: Set up production monorepo tooling
user_story: As a developer, I need the repo to install, build, test, and lint consistently.
acceptance_criteria: package manager configured; TypeScript base config works; CI workflow runs; README setup works

title: Port ROS design tokens into production UI package
user_story: As a developer, I need reusable tokens and base styles matching the approved ROS brand.
acceptance_criteria: tokens exported; styles imported by web app; sidebar/card/button/table styles available

title: Initialize Prisma and Postgres schema
user_story: As a developer, I need the database schema migrated so core objects can persist.
acceptance_criteria: Prisma generate works; migration runs; core tables created; env example documented

title: Add managed authentication scaffold
user_story: As an owner, I need secure login before any workspace data is visible.
acceptance_criteria: protected app routes; user identity available; unauthenticated users redirected; role seed supported

title: Create Koinonia workspace seed
user_story: As an owner, I need a default Koinonia workspace to contain users, objects, and settings.
acceptance_criteria: workspace seed creates Koinonia; settings stored; dashboard queries scoped by workspace

title: Implement Object API with Prisma persistence
user_story: As a user, I need to create, view, update, and archive shared objects.
acceptance_criteria: GET/POST/PATCH endpoints work; validation exists; archived objects excluded by default; timeline event created on update

title: Implement object relationship API
user_story: As a user, I need linked objects to show context across modules.
acceptance_criteria: relationships can be created/deleted; object detail returns related objects; relationship types stored

title: Build database-backed Object Explorer UI
user_story: As a user, I need to search and filter shared objects in the app.
acceptance_criteria: object list loads from API; filters by type/status/health; detail panel opens; related objects display

title: Create timeline event service
user_story: As a user, I need an audit trail when meaningful changes occur.
acceptance_criteria: timeline events created for object create/update/archive; object-specific timeline endpoint works; UI displays events

title: Build CRM relationship module MVP
user_story: As a Koinonia user, I need to manage agents, clients, brokerages, and referral partners.
acceptance_criteria: relationship object type supported; list/profile views; next action field; follow-up task creation

title: Build transaction module MVP
user_story: As a coordinator, I need to manage transaction status, health, deadlines, tasks, and exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: transaction object profile; status/health updates; linked property/client/tasks; exception panel

title: Build operations work queue MVP
user_story: As an operator, I need to see prioritized tasks and complete work.
acceptance_criteria: tasks list by priority/due date; complete action; owner assignment; dashboard due counts update

title: Build basic invoice and payment MVP
user_story: As an owner, I need to track invoices, payments, and revenue by service.
acceptance_criteria: invoice CRUD; payment record; paid/pending status; revenue metrics endpoint

title: Build repository metadata MVP
user_story: As a user, I need to find certified objects, templates, and playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: repository items stored as objects or metadata; search works; certified object list visible

title: Add read-only Copilot context endpoint
user_story: As an owner, I need AI recommendations grounded in object context without direct writes.
acceptance_criteria: endpoint accepts question and object IDs; returns answer with references; no mutations performed

title: Implement dashboard metric service
user_story: As an owner, I need dashboard KPIs computed from database records.
acceptance_criteria: active objects, critical objects, tasks due, revenue metrics computed from DB; no hardcoded KPI values

title: Build notification model and list UI
user_story: As a user, I need alerts for critical work and follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: notifications table used; notification list displays; mark read/resolve supported

title: Create workflow definition storage
user_story: As an operator, I need reusable workflow definitions tied to service objects.
acceptance_criteria: workflow definitions stored; workflow runs can start; current stage stored; linked to object

title: Add safe automation test runner
user_story: As an admin, I need to test automation rules before enabling them.
acceptance_criteria: rules can be listed; test endpoint returns proposed actions; no automatic destructive writes

title: Add permissions checks to APIs
user_story: As an owner, I need access controlled by role and workspace.
acceptance_criteria: workspace scoping enforced; role permissions checked for write actions; tests cover denial cases
